info.name: To-Do List API (Laravel)
info.description:
A RESTful API for managing Category and Task resources in a To-Do List Management System. Built using Laravel 9, Eloquent ORM, and MySQL.

All endpoints require the `Accept: application/json` header and return structured JSON responses.

item.name: Categories
item.description: Endpoints to manage Category resources. A category organizes tasks into groups.

response.name: Success

request.description: Create a new category. The category name must be unique and is required.

response.name: Validation Error (Duplicate/Missing Name)

request.description: Retrieve details of a specific category along with its tasks.

response.name: Success

request.description: Update details of a specific category.
Delete a category. Deleting a category automatically deletes all tasks associated with it (Cascade Delete).

item.name: Tasks
item.description: Endpoints to manage Task resources. A task belongs to a category and represents a to-do item.

request.description: Retrieve all tasks. Can optionally filter tasks by sending `category_id` as a query parameter.

response.name: Success

request.description: Retrieve tasks belonging to a specific Category ID.

response.name: Success

request.description:
Create a new task under a category.

- `category_id` (integer, required) - Must exist in `categories` table.
- `title` (string, required)
- `description` (string, optional)
- `is_completed` (boolean, optional, default: false)
- `due_date` (date/datetime, optional)
